credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: A dark leather suitcase manufactured by Crouch and & Fitzgerald, with brass hinges and locks and the initials  A.S. on the side.  The contents of the suitcase contains four(4) boxes of  wooden handled paintbrushes, with various thickness, mostly plain or varnished wood, some with painted red or black handles. The various manufacturers include: Artco; Bavaria; Grumbacher; Newman; Winsor Newton; Lucien Lefebvre-Foinet; Pelican; Rubens; Friedrichs; Sentry; and Diamond & Fitch. Of the four boxes of paint brushes in the suitcase: there are 2 brown boxes, 1 white box and 1 black box of bristle brushes.  There is an additional box - 1 blue box of miscellaneous supplies.
